newsitem.title: UK: Argentina plans to borrow further $6.5 bln in '97.
newsitem.headline: Argentina plans to borrow further $6.5 bln in '97.

text.p: Argentina plans to raise a further total of $6.5 billion on international and domestic capital markets in 1997, a senior Argentine official said on Wednesday.

"Argentina wants to raise a further $3.5 billion in 1997 on the international capital markets and $3.0 billion on the domestic capital market," Miguel Kiguel, undersecretary of finance told a conference.
He said Argentina wanted to follow an aggressive liability management strategy.
This would included extending debt maturities, diversifying international funding sources, pre-financing and the development of the domestic treasury market, Kiguel said.
